ground_truth.root_cause_type: Authorization/RBAC (Admission) Denial - HTTP 403 Forbidden on pod creation
ground_truth.recommended_action: Review the RBAC ClusterRole/RoleBinding and any admission control policies (e.g., OPA Gatekeeper constraints) applied to the kube-system namespace that are denying 'create pods' for system:serviceaccount:kube-system:replicaset-controller and 'create events' for node service accounts in the loki namespace. Update or exempt the policy/role bindings to restore the required permissions, then verify the affected ReplicaSet (policy-test-5bc859c67f) and Loki pods can successfully create resources.
